title: The normal distribution
caption: Heights of adult women follow a bell-shaped curve, here with mean 163 cm and standard deviation 7 cm. About 68% of values lie within one standard deviation of the mean (156–170 cm) and about 95% within two (149–177 cm).
alt: A bell curve centred on 163 centimetres with the region from 156 to 170 shaded darker and 149 to 177 shaded lighter.
description: The horizontal axis is height in centimetres, from 135 to 191.
The curve peaks at the mean, 163 cm, and is symmetrical.
The darker band, 156 to 170 cm (mean ± 1 standard deviation), holds about 68% of the area.
The lighter band, 149 to 177 cm (± 2 standard deviations), holds about 95%.
